## PII Determination

Answer each question below. If any answer is "Yes," a full Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA) is required.

| # | Question | Yes / No | Notes |
|---|----------|----------|-------|
| 1 | Does the tool collect, store, or process Personally Identifiable Information (PII)? |  |  |
| 2 | Does the tool collect, store, or process Protected Health Information (PHI)? |  |  |
| 3 | Does the tool link PII across multiple data sources? |  |  |
| 4 | Does the tool create new PII (e.g., user accounts, tracking IDs)? |  |  |
| 5 | Is PII visible to users other than the data subject? |  |  |
| 6 | Does the tool transmit PII outside the organization? |  |  |

## Threshold Determination

- [ ] No PII involved — PIA not required
- [ ] PII involved — Full PIA required (contact Privacy Officer)
- [ ] PHI involved — Full PIA + HIPAA review required
